prior_attempt.prompt: Use case precise-object-edit. Edit #213 Red-chested Owlet current v2 trio. Change ONLY BOTH ADULTS' claw plates: make proximal/basal two-thirds of each exposed claw pale yellowish horn, with distal pointed tips dark charcoal. Preserve shape/count/curves and natural gripping branch. Do not recolour yellow scaled toes or tarsal feathers. Preserve entire right older juvenile unchanged including its provisional claw colour and formed wing/tail; preserve adult eyes/bills/plain crowns/body/plumage/near-equal size, rainforest, every title/geographic note/rolelabel/scientificpendingfooter. No new sexratio/age/flight/nest claim. Same1536x1024.

edits.result: Fullplate and footcrop: proximal claws still largely grey; not yet yellowishbase/darktip. Sideflanks drifted warmer than target though within guide broadrufous range; do not claim non-target pixels unchanged.

prior_attempt.correction_prompt: Precise-object-edit #213 current image. Previous edit left BOTH ADULTS claws predominantly grey. Change ONLY the hard CLAWS (not toes): each claw's basal/proximal 70 percent must visibly be pale YELLOWISH HORN, distal final 30 percent charcoalblack. Sharp clear material transition, natural horn sheen, NOT uniformly grey with white highlight. Keep claw shape/count/curve and perch contact. Preserve every other pixel as closely as possible, particularly juvenile unchanged, yellow toes, all feather colours, legs, labels/footer/rainforest. Do not change flanks again.
prior_attempt.review: 实际查看最终完整图和足部放大图：成鸟爪根较浅、爪尖深色，但大部分爪片仍灰黑，黄角质基部未充分呈现。两次imagegen编辑未解决该色彩目标，明确NEEDS_CORRECTION，不标科学通过。爪形/趾数/自然抓持保留；幼鸟已形成翼尾未缩短。成鸟胁部首次编辑变暖，处图鉴赭棕宽范围但非原图像素保留；精确pycrafti色彩仍需照片校准。年龄/飞行未知，sciencefalse。归档为有未解决项的修订尝试，不能宣称爪色校准成功。
prior_attempt.lesson: 问题—细小爪片颜色编辑两次仍不足；证据—Mikkola368黄角质暗尖，当前放大仍灰；修改—两次限定成人爪片；复查—仅基部明度变浅，目标未达，入优先修订队列。规则：不能以提示的70%当测量或既成效果；细部编辑须检查裁图，跨区漂移需记录。后续需提供局部参考/更明确的目标，不能当全库验证有效。
